pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: features/votetrack/ledgerSource.test.ts:6 The /hlasovani source guards match raw file text with no comment or string normalisation and give no reason for the raw read, so a positive assertion like the record/outcome import check can be satisfied by a comment that only describes the convention.

techniques.evidence: features/votetrack/ledgerSource.test.ts:12 The positive presence check runs over unstripped source, so prose can satisfy it. The technique calls an unexplained raw read indistinguishable from the defect. The sibling pageSource.test.ts in data-releases does strip comments.

features/votetrack/ledgerSource.test.ts:14 The key is an identifier name. A local copy of the outcome set under any other name passes, and the test title claims the property ('carries no two-way outcome ternary') instead of declaring itself a floor.
features/votetrack/ledgerSource.test.ts:47 Checks the instrument before the result: the slug extractor has to find a non-trivial list before the equality check can count.

features/votetrack/chronicleCap.test.ts:106 Population-sensitive test that the display cap is not a data cap: the fixture is larger than the cap, and chronicleTotal and every other field have to be cap-independent.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: features/data-releases/pageSource.test.ts:12 The /data source guard does normalise away comments, but only with a regex pass that does not track string, comment and code state and keeps no seeded describe/call pair. The technique names exactly this as the way the stripper breaks silently.

techniques.evidence: features/data-releases/pageSource.test.ts:12 Comment stripping is a pattern pass; the technique says 'a pattern pass is not enough' and requires the seeded pair. Absence asserts (lines 26-27) are paired with a presence assert (line 28), which is partly conformant.

features/atlas/sealTables.test.ts:30 Falsifies the extractor ('nástroj čte netriviální seznam'), and arrayLiteral throws at line 15 when the constant is missing, so a lost needle is a could-not-run rather than a pass.

features/data-releases/manifest.ts:64 'unevaluable' (sentinel could not reach the data) and 'none' (never ran) are separate states that are never read as a pass. Null invariant counts are kept apart from 0 of 0, and pageSource pins that.
features/data-releases/manifest.ts:185 The certification pointer names the exact manifest hash it was measured on. A missing exact match becomes 'none', never the nearest other verdict.
features/data-releases/DataReleasesPage.tsx:47 The display cap is named as such, the page counts the remainder (lines 507-511), and manifest.json carries the full list.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: features/money/contractDates.test.ts:104 The guard slices moneyLoader.ts by two literal markers it never asserts are present. If readCompanySupplies is renamed, indexOf returns -1, the slice is empty, and the not.toContain check passes while checking nothing.

techniques.evidence: features/money/contractDates.test.ts:105 Absence assertion over a window that can be empty. Nothing checks the instrument (the window is non-empty and the markers were found) before the result.
features/money/contractDates.test.ts:104 The location key is a function-name string. Renaming the function keeps the behaviour and clears the check.

features/money/contractDates.test.ts:112 Only block comments are stripped, so the positive toMatch(/displaySignedOn\(c\)/) at line 114 is satisfiable by a // line comment. Line 95 reads profileMoney.ts raw for a positive match, also unexplained.
